title: How Many Dragons to BEAT a Chess YouTuber? (feat. Chess Vibes)
summary: Odds series: iwantcheckmate (White) plays with only his king plus N Dragons against National Master Nelson (ChessVibes)'s full standard army. The Dragon moves like a knight or a bishop. He starts with one Dragon and adds one extra Dragon after every game until he wins; he wins with 7 Dragons.
rules: White starts with K + N Dragons only (game 1: N=1); Black has the full standard army.
Dragon = bishop + knight compound (archbishop/princess); slides as a bishop (blocked by pieces), leaps as a knight.
After each game (loss) add one more Dragon for White.
Normal chess rules otherwise (castling n/a for White, check/checkmate, stalemate draw); pawns promoting may choose a Dragon.
win_condition: Checkmate the opponent; the challenge records the Dragon count at which White first wins.

opponent.name: NM Nelson Lopez (ChessVibes)
opponent.avatar_description: Facecam of Nelson; recreate as cartoon avatar of a smiling man with headphones (original art), name 'ChessVibes'.

setup: Game N: White Ke1 plus N Dragons placed on the first rank around the king (e.g. d1,c1,f1,b1,g1...); Black standard full army. FEN game1 (approx): rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/8/3DK3 w kq - 0 1
events: After each game: Dragon count +1 (progression ladder 1..N)
visual_fx: dragon legal-move dots show both diagonal and L-shaped targets
